enter.code: enterBeat() calls clearGuidedStoryObjective() unconditionally, then activateSettlementGuidance(actorId) republishes the settlement objective for the live milestone state.
enter.observed: objective settle:wait-night, markerLabel "SECOND HEARTH · WAIT FOR NIGHT", health ready, requiresMarker true; marker chip "second hearth · wait for night · 0m" resolves the exact label.

change.code: tickSecondHearth re-runs activateSettlementGuidance every tick until BOTH safeRestCompleted and twoWorldHandoff exist; activateGuidedStoryObjective dedupes on id so the HUD is stable. When night opens, guidance flips wait-night -> rest; on rest commit it becomes the terminal settle:second-hearth-settling hold.
change.note: settle:rest existed for ~51ms in the movie lane because completeEmergentMovieSafeRest commits rest in the same frame the night predicate opens. A human player holds settle:rest until they physically rest.

completeAndClear.code: once("second-hearth-rest") latches: setWorkOrder([]), setScoreIntensity(0.36), showCaption(closing line, 6500ms). After runtime.elapsed >= latch + 5.5s, completeStory() marks ch9Hearth/complete/senses, setVoxelRealityStage("alive"), setStoryForcedDayPhase(null) and sets snapshot {active:false, chapter:"complete", beat:"done"}. The beat transition to done runs the primary bridge storyDirector.onBeatEntered -> enterEmergentStoryBeat(done), whose unconditional clearGuidedStoryObjective() drops the settling objective; the done case has no re-activation arm, so the store itself reads null (not merely an unmounted HUD).

markerAndWorkOrderMapScope: markerAndWorkOrderMap holds every shipped settlement objective that both requires an exact directional marker and carries its kind action verb or input on the final work-order line. Objectives with requiresMarker false are preserved with the same fields in markerlessObjectives; marker-bound objectives whose final line does not carry the kind verb are preserved verbatim in nonActionableFinalLineObjectives. No shipped copy was reworded to satisfy the gate.

markerlessObjectives.note: the only shipped guided objective with requiresMarker:false; its work order is a state statement, not a verb — it is the authored terminal hold before completion
markerlessObjectives.baselineFinding: The shipped terminal hold states that the hearth is safe and asks the player to let the handoff settle. Both lines are status, not a verb or an input, so it does not satisfy the actionable-work-order contract that markerAndWorkOrderMap encodes. It is recorded here verbatim as the shipped baseline rather than reworded. It is also the only shipped guided objective with requiresMarker false.
